plugins.name: editorial-os
plugins.description: Plan editorial strategy, audit content gaps, map competitors, build calendars, draft content, write email subject lines, and repurpose for social — all from your existing documents. Google Drive is your source of truth.

skills.name: calendar-planner
skills.description: Build resource-realistic 90-day content calendars grounded in configured pillars, real team constraints, live calendar data, and audience performance patterns. Never plan more than the team can execute. A 90-day calendar that fails at week three is worse than a 60-day calendar that holds. Used by /calendar.

skills.name: client-context
skills.description: Read a client's Google Drive folder and build complete editorial context from real documents — brand guides, audience personas, competitor analyses, content history, performance data. Replaces config files and onboarding interviews. Called silently at the start of every command. Your documents are the config.
headings: Multiple Documents of the Same Type

skills.name: competitive-intel
skills.description: Apply honest competitive analysis methodology. Map content battlefields against configured competitors, identify real gaps (not wishful ones), and find defensible white space. If a competitor is strong, say so. White space that doesn't exist isn't an opportunity. Used by /competitor command.

skills.name: content-strategist
skills.description: Apply strategic content judgment — pillar health assessment, gap identification, opportunity prioritization, and recommendation sequencing. Frame findings in terms of business goals, not content metrics. Content metrics are inputs. Business outcomes are the output. Used by /audit and /calendar.
headings: Question 3 — Does It Advance the Primary Goal?

skills.name: editorial-config
skills.description: Load client context at the start of every command by calling client-context skill. Interpret Drive documents into structured editorial intelligence — competitors, pillars, audience segments, constraints, content history, and performance baselines. Run silently. Never narrate the loading process.
headings: Email Benchmarks (Use Only When No Real Data Available)

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Content gap analysis against your pillars and competitive landscape. Identifies what's missing, what's underperforming, and what to build next — sized to your actual team capacity.

commands.name: calendar
commands.description: 90-day content calendar built from real pillars, real constraints, and live seasonal data. Never plans more than the team can execute. Includes repurposing chains and contingency planning.

commands.name: competitor
commands.description: Competitive content analysis. Maps battlefields against your competitors, finds real white space, and identifies defensible positions — sized to your team's ability to win and hold ground.

commands.name: draft
commands.description: Draft content in your brand voice — blog posts, newsletter sections, landing page copy, case studies, or any editorial format. Uses your brand guide and audience context from Google Drive when connected.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Connect your Google Drive folder so every command reads your real documents — brand guide, competitor analysis, audience personas, past content. Three questions, 60 seconds. Optional — every command also works without setup.

commands.name: social-pack
commands.description: Turn one piece of content into a full social media package — LinkedIn posts, Twitter/X threads, and short-form hooks. Written in your brand voice with real posting schedule when configured.

commands.name: subjects
commands.description: Generate 10 email subject line variants with preview text, strategic analysis, A/B test plan, and mobile preview. Uses real brand voice and benchmark data when connected.
